evidence.quote: The most important sacrifices in the Shang Dynasty as the oracle bone inscriptions were Baiji and Yuji, the intentions of which were completely opposite: Baiji was held to pray for blessings and Yuji was held to get rid of misfortunes. The deities of mountains and rivers and other natural objects were also offered with Baiji in diversified ways and complicated procedures. The Yuji was just the sacrificial ceremonies of averting or exorcising, the goals of which were to avoid disasters and warfare and to get rid of devils and diseases.

abstract: 连劲名《商代的拜祭与御祭》以殷墟甲骨刻辞为核心材料，对商代的拜祭与御祭两类祀典进行系统的事类整理。论文先论拜祭，分述单独受祭的祖先与旧臣、合祭与延续形式、拜年拜雨及自然神、拜生、拜嬴、拜祭与军事等；再论御祭，讨论御祭与祓禳、血祭、大御、御祭中的苟、御繇与御疾、御祭中的人物、祖先与自然神等。全文通过大量宾组、历组、无名组、师组等卜辞辞例，说明拜祭为求福，御祭为除祸，揭示了商代祭祀在政治与宗教生活中的重要地位。
